claim_boundary: This source manifest records configured test intent only. CONFIGURED_UNRUN is not execution evidence or a support claim. A component remains unestablished on a coordinate until a later exact run emits bounded evidence for the catalog and manifest digests named by that run.

status_vocabulary.CONFIGURED_UNRUN: The repository configures the mapped tests for this coordinate, but this manifest records no execution result.
status_vocabulary.NOT_CONFIGURED: The repository does not currently configure the mapped component contract for this coordinate.
status_vocabulary.UNSUPPORTED: The repository path explicitly does not offer this component contract on this coordinate; this does not characterize upstream capability.

components.label: Artifact freeze and seal verifier
components.test_scope: Exercise exact-byte freeze, finite cryptographic seal, external-anchor, verification, and thaw behavior. Passing does not establish privileged-write prevention, trusted time, or untested filesystem semantics.

components.label: VSTD-1 generic-run receipt validator
components.test_scope: Execute the bounded command fixture, validate and inspect its receipt, and rerun it through the public command-line interface.

components.label: Bounded operating-system result comparator
components.test_scope: Exercise positive, conflicted, incomplete, malformed, and binding-drift platform-comparison cases over recorded receipts.

components.label: Recorded provenance policy verifier
components.test_scope: Exercise provenance-policy acceptance and rejection over bounded data-receipt fixtures.

components.label: SCITT native-evidence consumer
components.test_scope: Exercise semantic SCITT evidence mapping plus the local-key cryptographic example. Passing does not establish public transparency infrastructure or production trust roots.

components.label: VSTD and SCITT adjacent-result composer
components.test_scope: Exercise bounded adjacent-result composition, mismatch preservation, and the local-key cryptographic example without strengthening either native result.

components.label: VSTD-Graph assurance-log rechecker
components.test_scope: Exercise bounded assurance-log replay, dependency handling, and failure preservation.

components.label: Evidence-bound VSTD-Graph level rechecker
components.test_scope: Exercise evidence-bound Graph-level record rechecking and unresolved-evidence behavior.

components.label: VSTD-Graph receipt validator
components.test_scope: Exercise bounded Graph receipt validation, malformed input rejection, and policy interactions.

components.label: VSTD-1 satisfiability and grounding auditor
components.test_scope: Exercise the bundled satisfiability and grounding audit while constructing adversarial receipt-integrity fixtures.

components.label: Strict VSTD-2 geometry loader and semantic validator
components.test_scope: Exercise valid geometry loading, canonical normalization, and adversarial structural and numeric rejection.

components.label: VSTD-3 hardware receipt validator
components.test_scope: Exercise hardware-receipt validation using deterministic emulated evidence; no physical-device or vendor attestation is established.

components.label: VSTD-4 evidence-bound receipt rechecker
components.test_scope: Exercise evidence-bound receipt replay, mechanism binding, and non-establishment when evidence or mechanisms drift.

components.label: VSTD-4 grounded decision certificate kernel
components.test_scope: Exercise grounded certificate acceptance and refutation through the deterministic public demonstration scenarios.

components.label: VSTD-4 reverse-unit-propagation proof checker
components.test_scope: Exercise accepted and rejected reverse-unit-propagation certificates without inferring formula grounding or external truth.

components.label: Bounded VSTD-4 refutation proof producer
components.test_scope: Exercise satisfiable, unsatisfiable, and resource-bounded proof search with independently checked emitted refutations.

components.label: VSTD-5 witness corroboration rechecker
components.test_scope: Exercise witness rechecking while preserving refuted, unknown, conflicted, and independence-limited outcomes.
